Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 duplicate_codes;
 go_record(1);
 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 loop
 validate_commit;
 down;
 end loop;
 validate_commit; --For last record
 check_package_failure;
 commit;bell; 
 if not form_success then
 clear_block;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id');
 clear_block;
 else
 show_error('0000');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := '0';
exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('1706');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 check_package_failure;
 handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLICATE_CODES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE duplicate_codes IS
BEGIN
declare
present_record number(8);
j number(8);
present_code varchar(6);

begin
present_record := :system.cursor_record;
present_code := :reagent_code;
go_record('1');
for j in 1..present_record loop
if j = present_record then
 exit;
else
if present_code = :reagent_code then
show_error('2318');
raise form_trigger_failure;
exit;
else
down;
end if;
end if;
end loop;
end;
 

 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_COMMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_commit IS
BEGIN
 if :term_date is not null and :term_date < :eff_date 
 then
 show_error('2314');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :preparation_flag not in ('P','Y','N','I')
 then
 show_error('1815');
 check_package_failure; 
 elsif :reagent_code is null or 
 :reagent_name is null or 
 :preparation_flag is null or 
 :eff_date is null or
 :prequalification_flag is null or
 :last_modify_date is null or 
 :last_modify_user is null
 then
 show_error('2318');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_values IS
 rrec_cnt number(20); 
 where_clause varchar2(500); 
 
BEGIN
 select count(*) 
 into rrec_cnt 
 from valid_reagents 
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 and reagent_type = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_r_type, reagent_type) 
 and (control_flag = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_ctrl_ind, control_flag) 
 or control_flag is null)
 and ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_show_term = 'N'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) ) 
 or :ctrl_blk_1.s_show_term = 'Y') ;
 if rrec_cnt = 0 then
 show_error('2331');
 go_block('valid_reagents');
 else
 go_block('valid_reagents');
 where_clause := ' test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id and ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_show_term = ''N'' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate)) or :ctrl_blk_1.s_show_term = ''Y'') ';
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_r_type is not null then
 where_clause := where_clause||' and reagent_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_r_type' ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_ctrl_ind is not null then
 where_clause := where_clause||' and control_flag = :ctrl_blk_1.s_ctrl_ind'; 
 end if;
 where_clause := where_clause||' order by reagent_code asc';
 :system.message_level := 5;
 set_block_property('valid_reagents', default_where, where_clause);
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level :=0;
 end if;

END;
